data.text: Clubs at The VIDYA School provide collaborative spaces for students to cultivate special passions, teamwork, and creative ideas.

items.title: Robotics & Makers Club
items.description: Weekly hands-on circuit assembly, robot programming, 3D modelling, and preparing for national robotics contests.

items.title: Eco & Green Crusaders Club
items.description: Tree plantation drives, waste segregation, solar energy awareness, plastic-free campaigns, and school herb garden care.

items.title: Literary & Debating Society
items.description: Bilingual debates, Model United Nations simulations, creative writing, poetry recitations, and the Vidya Vaani newsletter.

items.title: Arts & Cultural Guild
items.description: Traditional handicrafts, theater drama, street plays, classical music, and preparing for the Vidya Lit Fest.
